description.en:
Kyōto, April 1928. Oshikouji Ryu is 17 years old, and is known as a Kendō prodigy, the 'Dragon of Kyōto'. He will inherit the property of the noble Oshikouji family, but prefers practicing Kendō. He enters Busen, the most renown martial arts school in the country, but his senpai are harsh and intolerable. But Ryu doesn't surrender and overcomes the problems, later on he impresses his senpai and they begin to like him.

This manga tells a great story against the richly textured background of historical Japan and China with refined and excellent artwork. Murakami's views on Chinese and Korean people is very warm, and not those of the previous invader and governor such as the extreme right party in Japan. Another interesting part of the manga is its rich depiction of Japanese colorful life. A typical example of the realistic style and a manga of high reputation in Korea and Japan.

One day a mysterious man appears from the wall who finds himself wounded and entrusts them with a "hand" which is called the hand of Zeus who harbors a mysterious power and energy. This hand can create a "Mouth" that is like a portal to be transported anywhere which they use to be able to escape the correctional room however having in their possession that hand is a great danger since strange beings are after it so they will have to face them.

description.en: When a friend asks Natsuki what high school club she's going to join, she cheerfully responds "the go-home club" (meaning, she's not going to join any of them). However, she soon realizes that this club actually exists at her high school, and she's just expressed interest in joining it! Before she knows it, she ends up as one of the two new members of "the go-home club," which is a small group of eccentric school girls. One of the girls likes fighting bears, while another is ridiculously rich. But what exactly constitutes the activities of "the go-home club"?

description.en:
From Del Rey:  
Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys wins! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship?

biography.en:
She is a manga artist and fashion writer, with numerous books published in both categories. Her manga and books have attained considerable popularity among young women in Japan. Though she primarily writes manga of the josei genre, one of her most popular series, [Sugar Sugar Rune](https://mangadex.org/title/465a2298-ec58-40cb-8b14-887c7604a884) (serialized in Nakayoshi) is targeted primary at school-aged girls. 

In one Oricon poll, she was voted the number eight most popular manga artist among females and thirteen in the general category. Her manga [Happy Mania](https://mangadex.org/title/4619cc7f-43ac-428e-a84c-81787511c039) was made into a television series in 1998, followed by [Hataraki Man](https://mangadex.org/title/ec0d8a40-f503-44ce-922f-a9b7620f0288) in October 2007. [Sakuran](https://mangadex.org/title/1b7191cf-9688-46ce-b48f-f8cfac493654) was made into a movie in 2006. 

Moyoko is married to famous anime director Anno Hideaki. Their relationship is portrayed in her autobiographical manga [Kantoku Fuyuki Todoki](https://mangadex.org/title/2840706b-de6a-4b03-8182-c875dc358ff1).

description.de:
Oohashi Rei - eigentlich eine ganz normale Büroangestellte - wacht eines Tages im Körper der Protagonistin ihres absoluten Lieblingsspiels "Revolution" auf. Eigentlich geht es in dem Spiel darum, mit einem von drei absolut wundervollen Prinzen zusammenzukommen. Ein klassisches Otome-Game, und wenn es nach Rei geht, auch das mit Abstand beste.  
Ihr Hauptinteresse lag dabei jedoch nicht etwa an einem der männlichen Charaktere, sondern an Claire François, der Antagonistin des Spiels.

Wird Rei es schaffen, eine romantische Beziehung zu ihr aufzubauen? Wie werden die eigentlichen Stars des Spiels, die drei Prinzen, auf diese Situation reagieren?  
Und was hält Claire überhaupt davon?
description.en:
Ordinary office worker Oohashi Rei wakes up in the body of the protagonist of her favourite otome game, *Revolution*. To her delight, the first person to greet her is also her favourite character, Claire François – the main antagonist of the story!

Now, Rei is determined to romance Claire instead of the game’s male leads. But how will her villainous lady love react to this new courtship?!
description.fr:
Rei Ôhashi, une simple employée de bureau d’une petite entreprise, se retrouve soudainement dans le corps de l’héroïne de son jeu vidéo de drague préféré, Revolution.
Maintenant sous le nom de Rae Taylor, elle est prête à accomplir son objectif.
Passer du bon temps avec les princes du jeu ? Non.
Son cœur appartient à la méchante de l’histoire, Claire François.
Bien décidée à la chérir et à rester à ses côtés, sa nouvelle vie commence dans un monde empreint de magie !
description.id: Seorang pegawai kantor biasa, Oohashi Rei, bereinkarnasi sebagai seorang Heroine bernama Rei Taylor di Game Otome favoritnya, "Revolution". Kebetulan lagi, orang pertama yang menyambutnya adalah karakter favoritnya, Claire Francois- antagonis dari cerita ini! Kini Rei bertekad untuk membangun hubungan romantis dengan Claire, bukan dengan pemeran utama pria. Lantas, bagaimanakah gadis jahat yang dia cintai akan bereaksi terhadap kemesraan baru ini?!
description.it:
La normale impiegata Oohashi Rei si sveglia nel corpo della protagonista del suo gioco otome preferito, Revolution. Per la sua gioia, la prima persona che incontra è anche il suo personaggio preferito, Claire François, l'antagonista principale della storia! Ora Rei è determinata a perseguire una storia d'amore con Claire piuttosto che con gli interessi amorosi maschili. Ma come reagirà la sua amata antagonista a questo nuovo corteggiamento?!
L'anime debutterà ad ottobre 2023!
Annunciato il manga ufficiale italiano!
description.ja: 乙女ゲーム『Revolution』の世界に、ヒロインのレイ＝テイラーとして転生した社畜OL・大橋零。そんな彼女の推しは攻略対象の王子たち…ではなく、悪役令嬢・クレア＝フランソワだった!　前世でゲームをやりこんでいたレイは、その知識と愛で、クレアとお近づきになることができるのか？
description.es-la: Oohashi Rei, una trabajadora de oficina ordinaria se despierta en el cuerpo de la protagonista de su juego otome favorito, "Revolution". Para su deleite, la primera persona en saludarla es también su personaje favorito, Claire Francois, ¡la principal antagonista de la historia! Ahora, Rei está decidida a enamorarse de Claire en lugar de los protagonistas masculinos del juego. ¿Pero cómo reaccionará la villana ante este nuevo cortejo?

description.en:
High school student Misumi Makoto is called into a fantasy world by the god Tsukuyomi, in order to be a hero. However, powerful others in this world aren't as thrilled to have him there, and they kick him to the edge of the world just as Tsukuyomi declares that he must leave Makoto to find his own way. Now it's up to Makoto to find his own way!
___
[Official English Light Novel](https://hanashi.media/series/tsukimichi/)
description.fr:
Makoto Misumi, lycéen japonais de 17 ans de petite taille et vice président du club de kyūdō de son école, se fait envoyer soudainement dans un autre monde par le dieu Tsukuyomi, qui lui apprend que ses parents sont originaires de celui-ci et qu'ils ont conclu un pacte avec la déesse locale pour être envoyé au Japon.

Mais la dite déesse le trouve trop laid pour être un héros dans la guerre entre humains et démons qui déchire son monde et le lâche littéralement dans les confins de celui-ci avec seulement la capacité de comprendre les langues des êtres non-humains. Tsukuyomi intervient et lui donne une partie de sa force.

Makoto rencontrera Ema une orc qui sera sa première amie et fera de Shin, une dragonne qui se métamorphosera en jolie femme, son premier serviteur. Celle-ci voit avec le pouvoir de Makoto un de ses pouvoirs devenir un "autre espace" qui accueillera au fil des rencontres dans ce monde de magie et d'épée de nombreuses personnes.
description.ja: 主人公・深澄真（みすみ・まこと）はごく普通の高校生……だったはずが、両親の都合で異世界へ召喚されることに。しかもその世界の唯一神である女神に「顔が不細工」と罵られ、問答無用で最果ての荒野に飛ばされてしまう。人の温もりを求めて荒野をさまよう真だが、出会うのはなぜか人外ばかり。ようやく仲間にした美女ふたりも、元竜に元巨大蜘蛛というクセ者ぞろい。とことん不運、されどチートな真の異世界珍道中のゆくえは――！？
description.pt-br: O estudante Misumi Makoto é invocado para outro mundo, para ser o herói. Mas a Deusa do outro mundo não gosta desse herói, por isso o envia para o fim do mundo. Agora Makoto tem de encontrar o seu próprio caminho nesse novo mundo de fantasia!

description.en:
25 years old Kikuri Hiroi is a "genius bassist" who leads the indie band "SICK HACK" and loves alcohol. 
She often gets drunk and breaks the equipment inside concert clubs, so she's often short of money. 
Living in a 52-year-old bathless apartment sometimes forces her to borrow showers from her friends. 
Regularly attacked by anxiety about her future, she counters that with a alcohol-fueled "happiness spiral". 
What is her daily life like...!?
description.ja: 主人公は廣井きくり（２５歳）。本編で「ぼっちちゃん」こと後藤ひとりから「お姉さん」と慕われる彼女はもともと陰キャだったが、バンド活動によりカリスマあふれる存在に。現在はお酒をこよなく愛し、よく酔っ払っている。はたして彼女の日常とは……！？
description.vi: Kikuri Hiroi -"tay bass thiên tài" của SICK HACK, nỗi kinh hoàng của các địa điểm hòa nhạc, kẻ ăn hại quanh năm suốt tháng, và hình mẫu tệ nạn toàn diện - từ lâu đã cho rằng không có vấn đề nào mà cô không thể giải quyết bằng cách nốc rượu. Cho dù đó là nền kinh tế đang suy thoái, hóa đơn tiền thuê nhà quá hạn, hay chỉ đơn giản là chứng lo âu xã hội luôn chực chờ trong đầu, chỉ một cơn say với vòng tròn hạnh phúc sẽ giúp mọi chuyện tự giải quyết chính nó... phải không? Chắc chắn cuộc sống thường ngày của cô ấy không phải là  thảm họa, phải không?!
description.es-la: Kikuri Hiroi, de 25 años, es una bajista prodigiosa que lidera la banda indie "SICK HACK" y le encanta el alcohol. A menudo se emborracha y rompe el equipo en los locales de conciertos, por lo que suele andar corta de dinero. Vive en un apartamento de 52 años sin baño, así que a veces pide prestada la ducha a sus amigos. Constantemente atormentada por la ansiedad sobre su futuro, la contrarresta con una espiral de felicidad alimentada por el alcohol. ¿Cómo es su día a día...?

description.en:
Asahi Nishizono has finally made her high school debut. But ever since she was a little girl, she's never been able to forget her first love, You Kazami. Even now, she can't take her eyes off his handsome face...

...or so she thought, until a huge shadow suddenly blocks her view.

“WHOA! JUUMONJI?!”

That's Touya Juumonji, Kazami's childhood friend who's always by his side. Not only is he huge, he's also ridiculously talented at all sorts of things. And somehow, Juumonji always manages to steal Nishizono's view of Kazami...?!

title.ja-ro: Anata no Hajimete, Watashi ni Kuremasu ka?

altTitles.en: Will You Give Me Your First Time?

altTitles.ja: あなたのハジメテ、私にくれますか？

description.en:
Miyuki works as a receptionist and is secretly dating Chiba, the vice president's secretary who is popular with everyone at the company. He is flawless in both appearance and behavior, yet he never makes a move on her, leaving her frustrated and impatient.

Unable to wait any longer, Miyuki decides to sneak into his bed at night—only to discover that the seemingly perfect Chiba is actually a virgin. She is thrilled by the gap between his composed exterior and his shy, flustered reaction.

Excited, she keeps teasing him until he suddenly turns the tables, declaring that he will give her plenty in return. His gentle yet intense caresses melt her whole body until she can hardly stay conscious.

As their secret office romance heats up, Miyuki cannot help but wonder: can this really be his first time?

description.es-la: La historia arranca de forma macabra cuando Doraemon descubre a Nobita riendo de manera siniestra mientras clava la punta de un lápiz sobre un dibujo del rostro de Gigante (Takeshi) para vengarse de sus abusos.

description.en: High school Second year Izumi is surrounded by girls that are a little peculiar: Haughty rich girl Shinonome and gamer junior Akaishi. Even his childhood friend and a transfer student turn up out of nowhere. It is the early 2000s. A nostalgic, heartwarming romance that tickles your memories of "those days" begins now!
description.es-la: Izumi, estudiante de segundo año de preparatoria, está rodeado de chicas un tanto peculiares: la altiva y rica Shinonome y la aficionada a los videojuegos Akaishi. Incluso su amiga de la infancia y una estudiante transferida aparecen de repente. Son principios de los 2000. ¡Comienza ahora un romance nostálgico y conmovedor que te hará recordar "aquellos tiempos"!
description.pt-br:
No segundo ano do ensino médio, Izumi se vê cercado por garotas um tanto peculiares: a rica e arrogante Shinonome e a gamer mais nova Akaishi. Até mesmo sua amiga de infância e uma aluna transferida surgem do nada em sua vida.

Estamos no início dos anos 2000.
Um romance nostálgico e reconfortante, que desperta as memórias “daqueles tempos”, começa agora!

altTitles.vi: Bản ghi âm lúc 5 giờ sáng

description.en: Ban Kuregata possesses ears that are acutely sensitive to sound. Because of this, the passing years have left him with scarcely any peaceful memories. That is, until Hino Shinonome appeared—the first person to tenderly embrace and treasure his uniqueness. Could her invitation to weave animated films together gently unfold a new chapter in Ban's life...?
description.vi: Kuregata Ban mang trong mình một đôi tai quá đỗi mẫn cảm với những thanh âm. Cũng bởi lẽ đó, năm tháng trôi qua hiếm khi đọng lại trong cậu những vệt ký ức êm đềm. Cho đến ngày Shinonome Hino xuất hiện—người đầu tiên dịu dàng đón nhận và trân quý sự khác biệt ấy. Lời ngỏ ý cùng cô dệt nên những thước phim hoạt hình liệu có khẽ khàng mở ra một chương mới trong cuộc đời Ban...?

altTitles.ja: デート・オア・キル～秘密のマッチング～

description.en:
Ayame, a top-notch assassin who has lived 25 years without any connection to romance, is convinced by a colleague to register on a dating app—while hiding her true identity!
She ends up matching with none other than her next target: Murai, the ruthless and cold-hearted young leader of a gang...!?
description.ja: 25年間恋愛とは無縁の人生を送ってきた、凄腕の殺し屋・絢芽。同僚のすすめで、正体を偽り恋活アプリに登録！すると、ターゲットである冷酷無慈悲なヤクザの若頭・無良井とマッチングして…！？
description.vi:
Ayame, một sát thủ hàng đầu đã sống 25 năm mà không có bất kỳ mối liên hệ nào với tình yêu, được một đồng nghiệp thuyết phục đăng ký trên một ứng dụng hẹn hò trong khi vẫn che giấu danh tính thực sự của mình!
Cuối cùng, cô ấy lại ghép đôi với không ai khác ngoài mục tiêu tiếp theo của mình: Murai, thủ lĩnh trẻ tuổi tàn nhẫn và lạnh lùng của một băng đảng...!?
Một bộ phim hài tình yêu giả tạo, nơi mọi thứ sẽ kết thúc nếu bí mật của cô ấy bị tiết lộ!!
description.pt-br: Ayame, uma assassina de primeira linha que viveu 25 anos sem qualquer conexão com romances, é convencida por um colega a se cadastrar em um aplicativo de namoro — enquanto esconde sua verdadeira identidade! Ela acaba encontrando ninguém menos que seu próximo alvo: Murai, o jovem líder implacável e insensível de uma gangue...!? Uma comédia de amor falsa onde tudo acaba se seu segredo for revelado!!

altTitles.ja: エウリュディケはいない

description.en:
Han Garam enrolls a prestigious arts university at the heart of Korea’s classical music scene, an institution that has produced world-renowned musicians.

His academic advisor, Professor Kim Heejae, a world-famous pianist, exploits Han Garam’s passion for his own ambition…

“what you hold dearest will become your greatest pain.”
description.ko:
세계적으로 유명한 음악가들을 배출한, 한국의 클래식계를 대표하는 예술 대학교에 입학한 '한가람'.
그의 담당 교수 '김희재'는 세계적으로 인정 받는 피아니스트로, 자신의 사명을 이루기 위해 한가람의 열정을 이용하는데...
"네가 제일 사랑하는 것이 너를 제일 아프게 하리라”

description.en: Haruka and Takumi had their bodies swapped when they fell down a staircase at a shrine. After several years of searching for a way to go back to normal, they find themselves increasingly aware of each other as their physical sex…
